info.title: Meteroid Client API
info.description: Browser-facing API. The customer's own routes are authenticated with a customer portal token; the public routes (pricing pages) with a publishable key (`pk_…`). It follows API v2's conventions: snake_case, prefixed ids, lists paged by cursor (`?limit=&after=`), errors as RFC 9457 problems (`application/problem+json`), and `Meteroid-Version: YYYY-MM-DD` to pin a version.

get.description: The customer the token was minted for.

403.description: The token does not grant read access

get.description:
What the customer may use, for the customer as a whole and for the resource the token
claims, as the server API's `GET /api/v2/customers/{id_or_alias}/entitlements` answers it,
with its `ETag`.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: A stored resource the token claims, by id

parameters.name: resource[type]
parameters.description: With `resource[key]`: a resource the token claims, by its type's code

403.description: The token does not grant read access, or does not claim the resource or the attributes

422.description: A resource not the customer's or of no type, or an unknown attribute or value

503.description: The snapshot could not be answered in time; retry

post.description:
Whether the customer may use `requested` more of a feature now, as the server API's `POST
/api/v2/customers/{id_or_alias}/entitlements/check` answers; `explain` and `current_count`
are refused.

200.description: Whether the customer may use the requested units

403.description: The token does not claim the resource or the attributes, or the request asks for `explain` or `current_count`

422.description: A negative `requested`, a resource not the customer's or of no type, or an unknown attribute or value

503.description: The check could not be answered in time; retry

get.description:
The `GET` form of `POST /api/client/v1/entitlements/check`: the feature by code or id, its
inputs as query parameters: `resource` (an id) or `resource[type]` and `resource[key]`, and
`attributes[<type>.<attribute>]=<value>`.

parameters.name: requested
parameters.description: The units about to be used, a decimal string; 1 by default.

parameters.name: current_count
parameters.description: Refused: it takes a secret key.

parameters.name: explain
parameters.description: Refused: it takes a secret key.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: A stored resource the token claims, by id

parameters.name: resource[type]
parameters.description: With `resource[key]`: a resource the token claims, by its type's code

200.description: Whether the customer may use the requested units

403.description: The token does not claim the resource or the attributes, or the request asks for `explain` or `current_count`

503.description: The check could not be answered in time; retry

get.description:
A product family's pricing page, as API v2's `GET /api/v2/pricing-pages/{family_code}` reads
it: its self-serve ladder priced in one currency and one option, card by card. Only what the
public page shows: a sales-led plan's hidden price is left out. Authenticated with a
publishable key, from one of its allowed origins when it lists any.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: A currency the ladder is sold in; the default when left out or not sold in.

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: An option alias of the page's switch; the first when left out or not on it.

401.description: Missing or unknown publishable key, or another credential

403.description: The key is not accepted from the request's origin

get.description:
The customer's current subscriptions in creation order, paged by cursor; cancelled, completed
and aborted ones are left out. Each reads as API v2's summary of a subscription.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items, 1 to 100; 20 by default.

200.description: A page of the customer's subscriptions

403.description: The token does not grant read access

422.description: The cursor or limit is refused

AppCountExplain.description: A limit counted by your app: the count, the last `set` and the adds since.

oneOf.description: The resource counted; absent for the customer as a whole.

BillingCycleReset.description: At each renewal of the subscription.

Cadence.description:
How often a price bills: `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semiannual` (every 6 months) or `annual`.
Usage and one-time prices read their usage or fee whatever it is.

CalendarReset.description: On calendar boundaries (the 1st of each month…), every `interval` calendar `unit`s.

CardExtra.description: An item of a card, in the order it reads.

amount.description:
A decimal string in the page's currency: the base price; per seat or unit; once; a
pack's. None for usage at a rate card's or by-dimension rates, and levels whose overage
varies.

from_lowest.description: `amount` is the lowest rate of its tiers: "from".

included.description: Units free before `amount` applies ("3 seats included").

lead.description: The card's price: the others read beside it.

name.description: The charge's name; empty for the base price.

oneOf.description: How often a recurring item bills.

CardLevel.description: A usage level a visitor may pick on a card.

amount.description: The card's amount with this level, a decimal string in the page's currency.

included.description: The usage included each period, in the metric's unit.

monthly_equivalent.description: `amount` per month, for a card billed on a longer period.

overage_rate.description: Per unit used above `included`; none when priced in a credit unit or left off the card.

CardLevels.description: The usage levels a visitor picks between.

levels.description: By the usage they include, smallest first.

metric_name.description: What the charge counts, as its metric names it.

oneOf.description:
A last stop past the largest level, sold by contacting sales; none when the ladder sells
nothing so.

CardPrice.description: What a card reads as its price.

amount.description: A decimal string in the page's currency: the card's lead price.

extras.description: The card's items in the order they read, one of them its `lead`.

from_lowest.description: The amount is the lowest of several levels: "from".

oneOf.description: The usage levels a visitor picks between, the card's amount reading the lowest.

monthly_equivalent.description: `amount` per month, for a price billed on a longer period.

partial.description: A charge could not be shown: never read as free.

oneOf.description: None for a plan billing only usage or one-time charges.

saving_percent.description:
Whole percent saved paying `amount` each `period` rather than the monthly price each
month, rounded down; none unless something is saved.

CheckLevel.description: A level, as checked: the customer as a whole, or the resource the check names.

oneOf.description: The subscription whose value applies here, when several include the feature.

in_overage.description: Past the limit of a level that allows usage past it and bills it.

primary.description:
The level the feature applies per (`applies_per`, else the customer): its value is the
feature's. The other levels can only cap it.

oneOf.description: With `level: resource_type`: the resource this level is for.
With `level: resource_type`.

CheckReason.description:
Why the check, or a level, refuses. When several apply, the first in this list is given.
New reasons may be added: treat an unknown one as a refusal.

CheckReasonType.description: What kind of refusal it is, to decide what to do about it.

ClientCheckEntitlement.description:
What a check asks through the client API, as API v2's check asks it. `explain` and
`current_count` take a secret key.

current_count.description: Refused: it takes a secret key.

explain.description: Refused: it takes a secret key.

feature.description: The feature, by code or id.

requested.description: The units about to be used; 1 by default.

oneOf.description:
The resource the token claims, `{"id": …}` or `{"type": …, "key": …}`; left out, the
customer as a whole.

ClientCustomer.description: The customer the token was minted for: who it is, as v2 reads a customer.

alias.description: The merchant's own id of the customer.

currency.description: What the customer is billed in (ISO 4217).

name.description: A company's name, or a person's full name.

ClientPlanRef.description: The plan a subscription is on, by code, with its name to show.

option.description: The option bought, by alias; none for a subscription older than options.

ClientSubscription.description:
A subscription of the customer, as v2's summary reads it (`GET
/api/v2/subscriptions/{id}/summary`), less what only the merchant reads: its MRR, invoicing,
custom properties, resource and external id.

ClientSubscriptionList.description: A page of `ClientSubscription` items, by cursor: pass `next_cursor` as `after` for the next.

data.description: The items of the page, in the list's order.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows: `next_cursor` is set when it does.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `after` for the next page; none on the last.

Contribution.description: A row's part in a level's value.

policy_override.description: The row gives its limit a policy of its own.

quantity.description: An add-on's instances bought; 1 for other rows.

oneOf.description: The value once this row applied; absent when it changed nothing (`discarded`).

units.description:
A limit per unit of a managed quantity: the units the deciding subscription holds, which
multiply `value` (`running` is the product).

CurrentPeriod.description: The billing period the subscription is in.

end.description: Exclusive; none for a subscription not billed by period yet.

CustomerEntitlement.description: A feature as the customer may use it.

oneOf.description: The resource type the feature applies per; none: the customer.
The product the feature belongs to; none for a feature of the whole catalog.

unit.description: What a number or a limit counts.

oneOf.description: The primary level's value, capped by the other levels; absent: not entitled.

CustomerId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `cus_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

CustomerKind.description:
A company, or a person (B2C): a person is named by `first_name` and `last_name`, and needs a
billing country. `company`: a business, named by `name` (the default); `individual`: a person,
whose `name` is made of `first_name` and `last_name`.

Dates.description: The subscription's dates. Days are ISO 8601 dates, moments RFC 3339.

activated_at.description:
When it was first activated (its start, its checkout or a manual activation); absent
before.

billing_start.description: When it is billed from: its start, after a free trial.

end.description: When it ends; none: until cancelled.

start.description: When its benefits start, a trial included.

DecidingCandidate.description: A subscription including the feature at the level, with the value its rows give there.

oneOf.description: The resource it is for; absent for a subscription of the customer as a whole.

EntitlementCheck.description: Whether the customer may use `requested` more of a feature now: every level must allow.

as_of.description:
When the usage the answer uses was counted: now, or, while usage cannot be read, the
last live count (`usage_source: live`).

attributes_ignored.description:
Attributes the request asserted that the stored resource holds other values of: the
stored ones were used.

in_overage.description: The request goes past a limit that allows usage past it and bills it: allowed, and billed.

near_limit.description:
A level is within 5% of a limit that refuses, or past it: check before every use, and do
not cache an answer that allows.

oneOf.description: Absent when allowed.

remaining.description: Left before the limit, not counting its grace.

retry_at.description:
When a refusal may lift: the latest reset among the refusing levels when each is a limit
that resets, or 30 seconds ahead when usage could not be read.

used.description:
`used`, `limit` and `remaining` are the refusing level's, else the primary level's; absent
without a limit.

oneOf.description: The primary level's value, capped by the other levels.

warnings.description: `usage_unavailable`: a level's usage could not be read, its `used` is absent.

EntitlementEffect.description:
How a row combines with the value of the owners before it: the feature's defaults, then the
plan and its version, the subscription, its add-ons and the customer's overrides, in that
order.

EntitlementId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `ent_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

EntitlementLevel.description: A feature at one level: the customer as a whole, or the resource the request names.

oneOf.description: The subscription whose value applies here, when several include the feature.
A limit's policy: the feature's, or the one a `set` row gives in its place.

primary.description:
The level the feature applies per (`applies_per`, else the customer): its value is the
feature's, and none there means not entitled. The other levels can only cap it.

oneOf.description: `resource_required` or `not_subscribed`.
With `level: resource_type`: the resource this level is for.
With `level: resource_type`.

used.description:
A limit's usage: the count your app reported, or the metric's events for this level over
`window`. Absent when it could not be read (warning `usage_unavailable`).

oneOf.description:
Absent on the primary level: not entitled (`reason` tells when a resource is needed).
Absent on another level: nothing caps the value there.

name.description: The plan and version's, the add-on's or the customer's name, where known.

EntitlementSnapshot.description:
Every feature with its levels. `etag` is also the `ETag` header: sent back as
`If-None-Match`, it answers `304` while the values are the same (usage is not part of it).

attributes_ignored.description:
Attributes the request asserted that the stored resource holds other values of: the
stored ones were used.

warnings.description: `usage_unavailable`: a level's usage could not be read, its `used` is absent.

EntitlementTier.description:
Where a row sits in the order rows apply in, first to last: the feature's defaults, the
plan, the plan version, the subscription, its add-ons, the customer's override, and an
override for one resource.

EntitlementValue.description:
The value a row gives, of the feature's type. A boolean takes `on` or `off`. A limit takes
`limit`, `unlimited` or `off`: `off` means not entitled at all, while a limit of 0 is
entitled to none. A value feature takes `number`, `text` (also a select's option) or `json`.

FeatureId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `feat_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

FeatureRef.description: A feature named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

FieldError.description: A field the request was refused for.

message.description: What is wrong with it, in English, for a person to read; it may change at any time.

path.description:
JSON pointer into the request body (`/charges/0/prices/1/model`), or the parameter or
header name (`limit`, `Idempotency-Key`).

FieldErrorCode.description:
Why a field is refused. New codes may be added without a new `Meteroid-Version`: a client
reads one it does not know as `invalid`.

FixedWindowReset.description: Every `interval` `unit`s, counted from the subscription's start.

IncludedBy.description:
Which subscriptions include a feature: the customer's (its value holds for the whole
customer), or only its resources' (it is answered per resource: name one).

LevelExplain.description:
How a level's value was made: each row's part, the subscriptions that could decide it, and
the counts your app reported.

LevelKind.description:
Where a value applies: for the customer as a whole (across all its resources), or for each
resource of `resource_type` (per site).

LevelResource.description: The resource a level is for: its type's code and its key value.

LevelsMore.description: Where the levels lead past their largest: sales.

plan_name.description: The sales-led plan of the ladder it leads to; none when it is the card's own.

NeverReset.description: A lifetime cap: the usage never starts again.

OffValue.description: Not entitled: a boolean switched off, or a limit not granted at all.

Origin.description: The row the value comes from.

PageOption.description: An option of the page's switch ("Monthly", "Annual").

alias.description: The option's alias, as `?option=` takes it.

PlanId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `plan_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

PlanRef.description:
A plan named by another resource: a subscription's and a checkout's at the version and the
option bought, a pricing card's as the plan alone.

code.description: The plan's code; its id when the code cannot be read.

option.description:
The option, by alias; none for a subscription older than options, or the plan named
alone.

version.description: The version number; none where the plan is named alone (a pricing card).

Policy.description:
How a limit behaves: when its usage resets and what reaching it does. The feature holds it;
a `set` row may give one of its own.

grace_pct.description: `deny` only: how far past the limit usage is still allowed, in percent of the limit.

resets.description:
When the usage counted against the limit starts again from zero. A limit your app counts
never resets. `billing_cycle` follows the subscription; with none, each calendar month.

thresholds.description: Percents of the limit at which an alert is sent, at most 10.

PricingCard.description: A plan of the ladder as its card reads.

contact_url.description: Where a sales-led card's button leads.

cta_label.description: The label of the card's button.

free.description: Its price is 0 with no other item: nothing to pay.

hide_price.description: The price is not shown: `price` is none and the card reads "Custom pricing".

highlights.description: The lines listed on the card.

option_note.description: Under the price when the plan does not sell the option shown ("Billed monthly").

options.description: The aliases of the options the plan sells in the currency.

plan.description: The plan, without version or option.

oneOf.description: None when the plan is not sold in the currency, or its price is hidden.

trial_days.description: The trial's length in days, when the plan has one.

PricingPage.description:
A product family's pricing page: its self-serve ladder, one card per plan, priced in one
currency and one option.

cards.description: One per plan of the ladder sold in the currency or by contacting sales, in ladder order.

currencies.description: The currencies a visitor switches between: those the ladder is sold in.

currency.description: The currency the page is priced in (ISO 4217).

option.description: The alias of the option shown; none when no plan is sold in the currency.

options.description: The options a visitor switches between.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem: every v2 error answers one, as `application/problem+json`.

code.description: What went wrong; branch on it, not on `title` or `detail`.

detail.description:
What went wrong with this request, in English, for a person to read; it may change at any
time.

errors.description: The fields refused, each at its path; absent when the problem is not a field's.

request_id.description: The id of the request, as in the `Request-Id` header: quote it to support.

status.description: The HTTP status of the response.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem, the same for every problem of its `code`.

type.description:
A URI naming the kind of problem, documented per `code`:
`https://docs.meteroid.com/api/v2/errors/<code>`.

ProblemCode.description:
What went wrong, specific enough to act on. New codes may be added without a new
`Meteroid-Version`: a client reads one it does not know by its HTTP status.

ProductFamilyId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `pf_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ProductFamilyRef.description: A product family named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

ProductId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `prd_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ProductRef.description: A product named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

Reset.description: When the usage counted against a limit starts again from zero.

ResourceId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `res_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ResourceName.description:
A customer's resource: `{"id": "res_…"}` for a stored one, or its type and key value,
`{"type": "site", "key": "s1"}`, which a check, a snapshot or a usage report may name without
the resource being stored. Send `id`, or `type` and `key`.

type.description: With `key`: the resource type's code, or its id.

ResourceTypeId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `rty_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

ResourceTypeRef.description: A resource type named by another resource.

code.description: Its code; its id when the code cannot be read.

SlidingWindowReset.description: The usage of the last `interval` `unit`s, up to now. Sends no alerts.

SnapshotResource.description: The resource a snapshot is for.

oneOf.description: A stored resource's id; absent for one named ad hoc.

SubscriptionId.description: An id in its prefixed form, `sub_` and base62; a request also reads its UUID form.

SubscriptionRef.description: A subscription named by another resource.

external_id.description: The integrator's own id of the subscription; paths take it in place of the id.

SubscriptionStatus.description:
Where the subscription is in its life: `pending_activation` before its start, or waiting for
its checkout or a manual activation; `trial_active` in its trial; `active` billing;
`trial_expired` a free trial ended without the checkout that starts billing; `cancelled`
ended by a cancellation; `aborted` cancelled before it was ever active; `completed` ended on
its end date.

TextValue.description: A text, or one of a select's options.

TrialState.description: The subscription's trial; absent when it has none.

days.description: Its length in days, from the start date.

ends_on.description: When it ended or ends; read on a single subscription.

free.description: Nothing is billed during it; read on a single subscription.

UsageSource.description:
Where the usage came from: `read` when checking, or `live`: kept up to date as usage events
arrive (Enterprise edition).

UsageWindow.description: The period a limit counted from events counts usage over.

end.description: Exclusive: the next reset. Absent for a limit that never resets.

customer_token.description: Customer portal token, minted by your backend with `POST /api/v1/customers/{id_or_alias}/portal-token`. It needs the `read` scope.

publishable_key.description: Publishable key (`pk_…`), created in Settings → API keys. Read-only and safe in a browser: it reads the public routes only, from its allowed origins when it lists any.
